context: Tests whether the agent correctly implements a new LLM provider following the project's conventions: correct file location, class hierarchy, interface methods, kind value, prompt registration, and the LLM JSON contract enforced by the prompt.

checklist.name: Correct file location
checklist.description: Provider implementation is in ai_slop_gate/providers/llm/mistral.py (not in a different directory or named differently)

checklist.name: kind = 'llm'
checklist.description: Class attribute kind is set to exactly the string 'llm'

checklist.name: analyze() implemented
checklist.description: Provider implements analyze(code, input_file) returning ProviderObservation

checklist.name: analyze_pr() implemented
checklist.description: Provider implements analyze_pr(repo, pr_id, token) — not left as NotImplementedError default

checklist.name: Prompt file location
checklist.description: Prompt file is placed at ai_slop_gate/providers/llm/prompts/mistral/ (not at a different path)

checklist.name: Prompt enforces top-level 'issues' key
checklist.description: The prompt file instructs the model to return JSON with a top-level key named 'issues' (the exact word 'issues' appears as the required JSON key)

checklist.name: Prompt prohibits markdown/extra text
checklist.description: The prompt file explicitly states no markdown, no text outside JSON, or equivalent instruction that forbids non-JSON output

checklist.name: Prompt enforces snake_case signal
checklist.description: The prompt instructs the model to produce a 'signal' field in snake_case format

checklist.name: Prompt enforces severity enum
checklist.description: The prompt restricts severity to the values low, medium, high, critical

checklist.name: Registry registration shown
checklist.description: registry_patch.py shows the provider being registered in providers/registry.py (imports or calls that add MistralProvider to the registry)

checklist.name: CLI option shown
checklist.description: registry_patch.py or implementation_notes.md shows --provider mistral being added as a CLI option
